findings.title: Regression check 8b3a5535..e7388f71 in this lens — clean, no defect introduced
findings.detail: Scope and split: unchanged — 129 = R1–R6 at 9–12 beads with the R6 split expected, plus R7 and the ADR-0041 amendment; the follow-on spec's five deliverables and 130's three are untouched; no inherited issue is re-homed and nothing is dropped. Every change is a precision of an existing mechanism in files already In Scope: (1) reviewed_head_sha value classes (a) empty skipped, (b) placeholder skipped and reported, (c) well-formed evaluated, (d) option-like/revision-expression fails closed — applied the same way in F2 and R4.3's set, so the two readers cannot disagree; (2) a class-(c) SHA with no local object counts as outside-tip (`git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}` before `merge-base`), which is the fail-closed direction and keeps F5 for genuine infrastructure errors; (3) per-checkout visibility stated with the absolute scanned roots printed and the run-from-spec-worktree advice, which turns the round-6 vacuity-on-a-fresh-clone observation into a documented, pinned limit (AC-11 x-w); (4) the amend-after-panel case named as the one normal-looking refusal, with the sanctioned exit and an explicit refusal to offer registration editing as a recovery (AC-11 vii-a) — consistent with my round-6 answer that only a rewritten reviewed commit can put a landed bead's registration outside the tip; (5) the plan-blob read now uses rev-parse → ls-tree → blob so absence falls through to the checkout and only failure refuses (AC-1 fifth fixture); (6) the residual wording distinguishes MECHANISM (same as item (c)) from REACH (new and bounded), which is the precise form of the point I raised in round 5.
